Rita: Kicking off canary for solaris12b-int4 on pool-12. Seeing sporadic OOMs on long-document chatbench and a small drop on our summarization eval (~1.9 ROUGE). Node log: `kv_cache_alloc failed`
Hugo: Runtime flags? prefetch / batch_window / max_new_tokens / slot_reserve?
Rita: Defaults: prefetch=true, batch_window=50ms, microbatch=4, slot_reserve=0.05, max_new_tokens=360. Failures around 700-900 generated tokens.
Talia: Any allocator metrics? slot_frag and freelist stats?
Rita: Pasted excerpt from node:
```
ERROR OOM kv_alloc
used=12.5GB free=0.34GB slot_frag=0.30
freelist_sweeps=3 compact_ops=0
```
Hugo: slot_frag 0.30 — consistent with fragmentation. Quick cheap tests: 1) prefetch=false + cap max_new_tokens=140; 2) keep prefetch but enable `compact_on_evict=true` + `slot_compactor_threshold=0.14`; 3) reduce `max_parallel_requests=2`. Which first?
Rita: I'm going to try #1 now: `curl -X POST https://canary/api/serve -d '{"model":"solaris12b-int4","opts":{"prefetch":false,"max_new_tokens":140}}'` (job 5932101240)
infra-bot: Canary deploy started for solaris12b-int4 on pool-12 (job 5932101240)
Talia: Also start a targeted AB: int4 vs hybrid-int8-qkv (int8 for q/k/v & attention) on 500 summarization prompts. If hybrid fixes ROUGE, suspect quant scales in qkv.
Hugo: Note: in past cases we reduced fragmentation by turning on `kv_prealloc_window=128` for long-gen flows to amortize allocations, but that increases baseline memory. Another option: `generation_windowing=200` to flush older kv frames periodically.
Rita: Canary update: after prefetch=false + max_new_tokens=140 we ran ~2k calls, zero OOMs. p50 latency +11-15ms, cost +6.8%. Starting hybrid-int8 AB (job 5932101248).
Talia: Good. If hybrid recovers quality, try two things: a) per-channel scale recalibration on q/k/v projection layers (calib set ~2k examples); b) hybrid fallback rule: if prompt length > 800 tokens, route to int8-qkv variant automatically.
Hugo: Also add telemetry: plot slot_frag over time per GPU and emit alert if slot_frag rises > 0.18 for >15min. Automation: rollback if OOM_rate >0.03% or ROUGE drop >1.2 pts on eval.
Rita: Will add alerts and the A/B harness. One more experiment planned: enable `compact_on_evict=true` + nightly `freelist_defrag` sweep in off-peak to see if we can restore `prefetch=true` without regressions.
infra-bot: Canary AB job started (5932101248) — running 500 summarization prompts for int4 vs hybrid-int8-qkv
Rita: Thanks everyone, posting AB results tomorrow. :thumbsup:
